This is an official video on Bespoke AI Refrigerator with Water & Ice Dispenser. The Auto Open Door has sensors on both sides that help you open the door when you lightly touch them. Newly updated Samsung Bixby allows you to control the AI Home refrigerator’s features remotely, and even open the fridge with just your voice. AI Energy Mode reduces your energy use by up to 10% by intelligently adjusting the compressor speed and the frequency of the defrost cycle, based on your usage pattern and surroundings. Water & Ice Dispenser provides you with a glass of chilled water or provides plenty of ice to cool down your drinks, without having to open the fridge.

description:
This video shows that Samsung DVM S Water was selected as the optimal HVAC solution for TORRE QUAD, the new workspace of Liverpool, one of Mexico's most trusted retail groups for over 175 years.

The water-cooled DVM S Water allows the outdoor unit to be installed indoors, maintaining a clean exterior while maximizing rooftop space. By reusing wastewater as cooling tower circulation water, it also contributed to achieving LEED Gold® certification.

A customized solution with Duct S in main work areas and 360 Cassettes in meeting rooms enhanced both employee comfort and operational efficiency.

Q: What differentiates Samsung DVM S Water at TORRE QUAD?
A: Samsung DVM S Water allows outdoor units to be installed indoors, helping maintain a clean exterior while maximizing rooftop space. It also supports efficient building operation through its water-cooled system design.
